_about: Carveth Read (1848-1931), English logician and evolutionary psychologist, Grote Professor of Philosophy of Mind and Logic at University College London. Raw IA OCR: On the Theory of Logic, an essay (Kegan Paul, 1878); Logic, Deductive and Inductive (3rd edition, revised and enlarged, Alexander Moring, reprinted 1908); Natural and Social Morals (1909); The Origin of Man and of his Superstitions (Cambridge, 1920); Man and his Superstitions (Cambridge, 1925). Held: The Metaphysics of Nature (A. & C. Black), whose only scan shows no printed year. His surname is a common English word, so only the full name form is used. US public domain. No uids minted. Added 2026-10-23: clean Gutenberg witnesses (slugs ending -pg) beside the raw OCR of the same works.
